purpose: Maintained input provenance and historical golden file identities for the nonrelease human collider witness. Binary inputs and generated artifacts remain outside Git.

retention.note: All 15 original artifact files were copied to external custody and independently SHA-verified before current-tree removal. The external receipt records machine paths; this source manifest does not bind a machine.
